title: Unfallwerkbank
description: Unfallwerkbank is an open-source browser and server toolkit for exploring, filtering, visualising and exporting official German road accident open data. It supports interactive Leaflet maps, cluster and heatmap views, context-aware filtering, local political request drafts, PDF/Word exports, optional AI-assisted assessment, and an optional Spring Boot analysis service for persistent location action briefs and prioritisation. The project is intended for civic-tech, municipal road-safety work, reproducible open-data analysis, research, journalism and advocacy around safer walking and cycling infrastructure.
notes: The Zenodo archive captures a release of the source code, metadata, citation instructions, documentation and release artefacts. Large generated accident-data outputs are intentionally not part of the reusable JavaScript package concept and may be distributed separately according to their source-data licences and provenance notes.
